title: Frequently Asked Questions
content:
Can I request custom Quranic or Hadith text?

You may submit a commission request, but it will not be auto-approved. The source, Arabic script and production artwork must be verified manually.

Are draft sizes and finishes guaranteed?

No. Only options marked as approved on a published product are confirmed.

How should I install my artwork?

Follow the installation guide supplied with the approved product. Hardware depends on final weight, wall type and hanging system.
